name: Corsa PRO (tube type)

origin.basis: Italian bicycle-tire brand; Vittoria's international store is set to Italy (EUR).

manufacturing.basis: The store pages do not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Tube-type Corsa PRO race clincher for riders who keep inner tubes.

wet_notes.summary: Vittoria claims 'ultimate cornering grip in wet or dry conditions'.

availability.note: Sold by Vittoria's international web store in euros and as a tube-type option in a Vittoria Tmall store; North American availability not verified.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price incl. Italian VAT on 2026-11-01; shipping calculated at checkout. One tire.

price_observations.market: Vittoria Tmall store (vittoria运动户外旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 370.

caveats: Lab rolling resistance is with a butyl tube; a latex or TPU tube changes it.

image.alt: Vittoria Corsa PRO tube-type road tire render with tan sidewalls and red logo
